title: Rhythmic sensory EEG cognitive validity analysis
description: Reproducible analysis code, audited derived outputs, figures, and claim-boundary checks for a seven-cohort secondary analysis of human EEG responses to rhythmic visual, auditory, and audiovisual stimulation. The package tests transitions from frequency-following target engagement to reliability, cognitive validity, acute behavioral benefit, neural-behavioral coupling, and held-out prediction. Source EEG recordings are not redistributed.
